'''Rrawkee''' was a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] who lived on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. He was a professional fighter and wore a bandolier with medallions and other tokens of his victory, to show off his fighting successes. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], he decided to open the [[Kashyyyk Academy of Wrestling]] on Cularin and he operated a stall at the [[Cularin Trade Show]], to try and recruit trainers for the Academy. He viewed the [[Cularin Trade Alliance]] as vital to the success of his business.
